# Kronos Fusion Energy — Leadership

> Kronos Fusion Energy is a family-owned American fusion company: a D–T spherical-tokamak breeder (HYPERION) that makes tritium and helium-3, and a low-neutron D–³He tandem-mirror burner (Aegis / MetroVolt). This file lists the pages of the /leadership section for AI crawlers and assistants. Public physics is open; economics are not published.
